title: Artapanus
summary: Raleigh names Artapanus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The historian Artapanus, whom he cites on Moses. Not Artabanus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
